exchange_balances.balance_method: rippled account_info on latest validated ledger once daily around 08:00 UTC

daily_same_wallet_change_xrp.method_note: Daily bars exclude exchanges whose wallet set changed that day; not a single fixed cross-day cohort.

known_methodological_gaps: No per-wallet daily history; only per-exchange totals are retained.
Same-wallet change cannot tell customer withdrawal from exchange transfer to an untracked wallet.
Daily bars exclude exchanges whose wallet set changed; daily bars cannot be summed into 7d/30d fixed-cohort totals.
Wallets include cold storage, wrapped-token backing and other non-customer reserves; not tradable float.
Regional categories use exchange HQ or registration jurisdiction, not customer residence or ownership.
exchange_balances.refresh: Balances once daily at 08:00 UTC; page regenerates hourly from stored rows.

binance_incident_comparison.interpretation: The October 30 daily aggregate decline is temporally aligned with the late-October-29 incident and close in magnitude, but the provider does not publish per-wallet daily history and the daily bar may exclude exchanges whose wallet set changed. Binance's 7-day net decline is smaller than the transfer. No causal attribution is established.

market_feature_admission.reason: The daily aggregate is temporally aligned but lacks per-wallet daily history and fixed-cohort coverage flags needed to isolate the stolen accounts; cold storage and non-customer reserves remain included.
